title: Create Table [CHECK Constraint]
description:
## CHECK
CHECK lets you add custom validation rules to columns. If an INSERT or UPDATE violates the rule, SQL rejects it.
```sql
CREATE TABLE employees (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    name TEXT NOT NULL,
    age INTEGER CHECK(age >= 18),
    salary REAL CHECK(salary > 0)
);
```
Now you can't insert an employee under 18 or with a negative salary.

You can also name your constraints:
```sql
age INTEGER CONSTRAINT age_check CHECK(age >= 18)
```
